First, to start this off with a REALLY silly question, as i usually only lurk and read (first time posting here).

Is there a search function on these forums? I couldn't see one  =\

 

Ok, now that the board noobishness is out of the way, i had a question about how Impaling Structure and Fueled Freeze interact. Adding an additional marker is fairly obvious, add an additional structure token. But do the structures also gain the benefit of the additional radius? Or do the structures not count as Zero doing the damage? And if they don't gain teh increased benefit, does this mean that Thermal Shockwave is the only abiity Zero has that DOES gain the increased area (didn't see any other radius attacks for him)?

Thanks a ton guys, i plan on showing this off at a game day tomorrow, and these were some of the initial questions my group had pop up. Also, i have seen it mentioned a few times about how the rulebook feels a tad incomplete, as it doesn't clearly state some of hte rules. Is there a faq running around anywhere that has clarifications?

Fueled Freeze adds additional radius to his Area Attacks, but not his Hazard Attacks. (Area attacks affect all targets within the radius; hazard attacks trigger against specific targets within the radius when those targets move or end turn.) Thermal Shockwave is Absolute Zero's only current Area Attack, but forward-compatibility is important; Absolute Zero may have another Area Attack someday.

 

Christopher has said that (hopefully Septemberish) www.sentineltactics.com will have a Card database, with FAQs and such. In the meantime, feel free to ask any questions here; there's invariably a response before too long.
